name: vrc-avatars
title: VRC Avatars
author: VRC Avatars
description: Lets every player pick their own look from the installed avatar packs: your VRChat or other humanoid avatar, turned into a pack with the Factorio Avatar Exporter for Unity. Press the avatar button in the shortcut bar (or Ctrl + Shift + A) to choose. Without packs, everyone stays the engineer.
